name: Seated Single-Leg Hamstring Stretch
summary: A seated unilateral static stretch targeting the hamstrings and posterior chain of the extended leg.

setup: Sit upright on the floor with your legs extended in front of you.
Bend one knee and place the sole of that foot flat against the inner thigh of your extended leg, allowing the bent knee to rest outward toward the floor.
steps: Sit tall through your spine and flex the foot of the extended leg toward your shin.
Hinge forward at your hips, reaching your hands toward your shin, ankle, or foot while keeping your chest lifted and spine long.
Hold the stretch at a point of mild to moderate tension in the back of the thigh.
Slowly release the hold, return to an upright position, and switch sides.
instructions.breathing: Inhale to lengthen your spine, then exhale as you hinge forward into the stretch, maintaining slow, deep breathing throughout the hold.
cues: Lead with your chest, not your forehead.
Hinge at the hips rather than rounding the lower back.
Keep the extended knee soft, not aggressively locked.

common_faults.fault: Excessively rounding the lumbar spine to reach the foot.
common_faults.correction: Keep your chest up and hinge strictly from the pelvis, even if you can only reach your knee or shin.

common_faults.fault: Hyperextending and forcing the knee of the straight leg down into the floor.
common_faults.correction: Maintain a micro-bend at the knee joint to protect the joint capsule while focusing the stretch on the muscle belly.

precautions: Avoid bouncing or forcing range of motion past comfortable tension.
